content: Bostat rufar fiyala

Tarfore Yusufe hibar gór sõloyare endilla hokum diye: "Ei manuššune zedun boi loizai fare, hedun gĩyu hitarar bostat okkolot bori do, ar hitara fotti zonor ṭĩya hitara fotti zonor bostar mukot di diyo.
Ze beggunor šoṛo hitar bostar mukot ãr rufar fiyalawa edde hitar gĩyu kinibar ṭiya di diyo." Toi hite Yusufe hoiyede mozin goijje.
Tarfordin binna fohor zehon oiye manuššunore hitara gadagun loi hentu faṭai diya oiye.

Hitara šude šohorottu niyoli beši dure no zaite Yusufe hibar gór sõloyare hodde, "Uṭ, manuššunore fisottu lorai za, ar tui zẽtte hitare doribigoi, hitarare hoibi, 'Tũwara balair bodole burai ka goijjo?
Iba loi no ne ãr munife fiyede edde gonafora gorede? Tũwara iyan ziyan goijjo, ek horaf ham goijjo!'"
Gór sõloyaye hitarare doijjegoi edde he hota okkol hitarare hoiye.
Kintu hitara hitare hodde, "Ãr malike endilla hota okkol kiyolla hor? Õnor gulam okkole endilla ham hono din no goribo!
So, ãra bostar mukot ze ṭĩya failam hin ãra Kenan dešottu uwafes tũwar hãse firai anni, hen abostat ãra õnor munifor góror šuna rufa kiyolla sur goriyum?
Õnor ei gulam okkol zar hãse iba fazaibo, hite moribo; ar ãra o ãr malikor gulam oiyum."
Toi hite hodde, "Bala, tũwara hodde mozin oibo; zar hãse fa zaibo, hite ãr gulam oibo, ar baki tũwarar hosuri sara oiba."
Toi hitara toratori goijje edde ek ekzone hitar nizor bosta meṛit lamaiye, edde zar zar bosta te kuille.
Toi hite ḍõr báiyor bostattu loti šuru gori šoṛo báiyor bosta foijjonto tuwaiye. Ar Fiyalawa Benyaminor bostat fa giye.
Toi hitara hitarar nizor hor faiṭṭe, edde zar zar bosta gadar fiṛot bandi loi uwafes šohorot firi giye.
Ehudah edde hitar báiyain okkol Yusufor górot aišše, ar Yusuf hehono heṛe aššil; toi hitara Yusufor sarme meṛit ũite foijje.
Yusufe hitarare hodde, "Tũwara goijjode in ki goijjo? Ãr ḍoilla manuše ze goni fare, hiyan ki tũwara no zano?"

Ehudaye hodde, "Ãr malikore ãra ki hoi faijjum? Ki hota hoiyum? Ãra nidušide hiyan ken gori dehai faijjum? Õnor gulam okkolor hosuri Allaye tuwai bair goijje. So, zar hãse fiyala fa giye hite edde ãra ãr ehon malikor gulam."
Kintu Yusufe hodde, "Endilla ham ãi hono din gori no faijjum! Zar hãse he fiyala fa giye lehar te ãr gulam oibo. Ar tũwara šanti bafe tũwarar bafor heṛe firizaigoi fariba."
Tarfore Ehudaye Yusufor ḍake zai hodde: "O ãr malik, foriyad gorir, õnor ei gulamore ekkan hota hoibolla ejazot do. Õnor gulamor uwore gušša no goijjo, õne, Feruwanor fuwainna.
Ãr malike hibar gulam okkolore fusar goijjila, 'Tũwarar baf bái ase ne?'
Ar ãra malikore zuwab dilam, 'Ãrattu ek burá baf ase, ar hibattu burá halor ek fut ase; ar hitar bái mora giye, ar hite ekela ek mar ek fut, hitar bafe hitare beši ador gore.'
"Toi õne õnor gulam okkolore hoila, 'Tũwara hitare eṛe anogoi, ãi hitare niz suke saiyum.'
Ar ãra ãr malikore hoilam, 'He zuwan bafore eri ai no faribo; hite hitar bafore eri aile, hitar baf mori zaiboi.'
Kintu õne ei gulam okkolore hoila, 'Tũwarar šoṛo báiyore zodi tũwarar fũwati no ano, tũwara ãr sarme ai no fariba.'
Toi ãra õnor gulam ãr bafor górot uwafes zaiyore, ãra ãr malikor hár hota hibare zanailam.
"Toi ãrar bafe hodde, 'Tũwara abar zo, ãralla hodun haiddo kini anogoi.'
Ãra hoilam, 'Ãra lamat zai no farir; zodi ãrar šoṛo bái ãrar fũwati take, toile ãra zai faridde, kiyollahoile ãrar šoṛo bái fũwati no takile, ãra manušwar muk sai no faijjum.'
Toi õnor gulam, ãrar bafe ãrare hodde, 'Tũwara zano ze ãr bouwe ãlla dui futore biyaiye,
henttu o ekzon ãttu giyegoi, ar ãi hoilam, "hite hameka hanhan oi giyegoi" hiyattu loti ãi hitare ar no dekilam.
Ehon ãttu itare o zodi loizogoi, edde hitar hono bifod goṭe, toile tũwara hitar dukke ei burá boyošot ãre fatalot lamai diba.'
"Ar ehon, õnor gulam ãr bafor munttu ãi hazir oile, edde fuwawa ãrar fũwati no takile, (zar foranor hitar foran loi gãta),
zuwannuwa ãrar fũwati naide dekile hiba mori zaibogoi, endilla gori õnor gulam okkole õnor gulam ãrar bafore šukke ei burá boyošot fatalot lamai dibo.
Ar õnor gulam ãrar bafor hãse ãi ei zuwanor zabin oi hoilam, 'Ãi zodi hitare tũwar hãse firai no ani, toile ãi ãr bafor hãse zibonbor hosurbon takiyum!'
"Hetolla aroz gorir, ei fuwawar bodole ãre õnor gulam hisabe rako, edde ei fuwaware hitar báiyaindor fũwati firi zaito do.
Ei fuware no loi zaiyore ãi ken gori ãr bafor hãse firizai faijjum? Edde bafor ze bifod goṭibo hin o ken gori sai faijjum?"
